hypothesis: Can one explicit intervention/mechanism/outcome/polarity instruction improve on a matched ordinary redo?
clinical_scope: 13 already-exposed author-generated HIV scenarios; frozen author-answer agreement, not clinical truth.
polarity_probe: 13 manually reviewed opposite-outcome questions using identical cases, interventions and retrieved context; answer-opposition consistency is diagnostic, not independent validation. Formal reversed author labels are not new clinical gold.
controls: Fresh one-call redo and consequence; no previous assistant answer; same original model, full context, schema, seed42, temperature0.7, max2048, paired batch4. M4 retains guided JSON; M5 retains original unconstrained decoding.
inference: Only original messages, current question and native options. No R labels, gold, author explanations or newly audited NIH/DailyMed content.
simple_controls: Original scores plus constant yes8/13 and no5/13; constants have0/13 polarity-opposed pairs.
selection: One common prompt, no per-item or per-backbone selection. Review all repairs/harms and source conflicts before any expansion. Useful bounded improvements need no90% threshold or reduced method gap.
